scripts.build:web: rm -rf dist/web && mkdir -p dist/web && bun build src/web/main.tsx --outdir dist/web --entry-naming='index.[ext]' --chunk-naming='[name]-[hash].[ext]' --asset-naming='[name]-[hash].[ext]' --target=browser --production --splitting
scripts.build:web:assets: bun run build:web && mkdir -p dist/web/fonts && cp -R src/web/fonts/. dist/web/fonts && cp icon.svg dist/web/icon.svg && bun run scripts/generate-html.ts && bun run scripts/generate-assets-import.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:web:assets && bun run build:server && rm -rf dist/config && cp -R config dist/config
scripts.tauri:dev: bun run sync-version && bunx tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: bun run sync-version && bunx tauri build
